propositions: a child closed with disposition class (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) and a durable replacement link cannot earn a completion-verifier attestation yet blocks parent certification with no remediation path available to honest operators

the close path exempts dispositions from completion verification at transition_close.py:253-260 but the certification path at llm/completion.py:170-199 demands a completion-verifier attestation on every closed child without a disposition branch, creating a deadlock
disposition-closed children with live replacement links should resolve certification through the replacement's own certification status rather than demanding an unearnable local attestation
the completion-verifier manifest for disposition closes must not claim a PASS verification that never occurred; it should record the disposition class and replacement ticket id instead
